Acquisition / Lead economics

Media cost per lead (CPL)

The media spend needed for one unique, valid lead attributed to the selected campaigns. We agree what counts as a lead, deduplicate submissions, and exclude spam before calculating this configured KPI.

currency / lead

How we use it

Compare the expense of filling your pipeline. We join advertising and CRM records to show whether lower CPL also produces qualified opportunities and customers.

Transparent calculationAttributed media spend ÷ unique valid attributed leads
media spend6,000
valid leads120

6,000 ÷ 120 = 50 currency units per unique valid lead.

Illustrative calculation. Not a client result or a universal benchmark.

Break the result down

  • Lead source and campaign
  • Market and audience
  • Form or offer variant

Questions we investigate

  • Are leads unique and valid?
  • Which sources create useful sales conversations?
  • Did attribution or the offer change?

Actions the evidence supports

  • Deduplicate and validate lead records.
  • Improve relevant forms and offer messaging.
  • Review qualification and customer conversion together.

Reporting contract

Ownership & cadence

Growth marketing lead
Weekly for matured lead collection windows.

Required data

  • Attributed media spend
  • Unique valid attributed lead IDs
  • Attribution window and validity criteria

Read the measure with context

Zero valid leads makes CPL undefined. Raw form events can include duplicates and invalid contacts. The attribution window and cost scope must be explicit; this media-only definition excludes creative, software, and staff costs.
